environment.description: Same Django application deployed on ECS Fargate with task-level ephemeral storage (20GB scratch, mounted at /tmp, isolated per task). CloudFront distribution d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy restricting origin fetch to requests bearing a valid CloudFront-signed header (x-origin-verify) checked by an ALB listener rule. The ALB's default action returns 403; only requests with header x-origin-verify matching a rotating HMAC secret (stored in Secrets Manager, rotated every 4 hours) are forwarded to the target group. The Fargate task runs with a read-only root filesystem EXCEPT /tmp which is task-scoped ephemeral storage. Security group on the ALB only allows ingress from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). The ECS task definition sets 'readonlyRootFilesystem: true' and the container runs as a non-root user (uid 1000) with a restrictive seccomp profile blocking symlink/link syscalls (unlinkat allowed, linkat/symlinkat denied).

config.tmp_storage: task-scoped ephemeral 20GB, not shared across tasks

cloudfront.origin_access: OAC with x-origin-verify HMAC header validation
cloudfront.signed_urls: RSA 2048-bit key pair, 1-hour expiry, IP-restricted policy

alb.forward_rule: header x-origin-verify matches current HMAC from Secrets Manager

container.seccomp_profile: custom - blocks linkat, symlinkat; allows unlinkat, open, write

config.network: no direct origin access - SG blocks all non-CloudFront IPs
